body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Dreamflyer demonstrated its personal virtual reality flight motion simulator during CES 2008 Unveiled NY Press Preview. Designed to offer enhanced flight simulation experience, it could be an efficient alternative to those who are not able to fly due to cost, weather or license limitations. It can also be used in homes, offices, airport lounges and museums, suggests the company.
